resolutions: The user superseded the earlier split uppercase lockup with one title-case Helvetica Neue SVG lockup at a fixed 102 by 24 ratio.
The standalone four-square SVG remains only for browser icons; auth and sidebar both consume the combined lockup asset.
current_flow: Auth and sidebar both render GantryLogo, which resolves the same base-aware public SVG through a currentColor CSS mask.

criteria_map.Single consistent lockup: Both consumers use the same GantryLogo component and h-6 w-[102px] dimensions.
criteria_map.Browser icons: The standalone four-square SVG remains the source for the favicon and 180px touch icon.
criteria_map.No behavior change: The change remains static browser identity rendering with no API, schema, configuration, or runtime change.

new_abstractions: GantryLogo is the single existing-use composition that owns the combined visual lockup.

citations.finding: The previous independent icon and wordmark rendering allowed visual-ratio drift.
The final lockup is a single public SVG asset shared by every visual consumer.
